Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "窗口明示允许在处置过程后保留限定材料。", "name": "explicit_retention_permission"}, {"meaning": "窗口明示禁止在处置过程后保留限定材料。", "name": "explicit_retention_prohibition"}, {"meaning": "窗口对不同材料或条件同时明示有限留存许可和留存禁止。", "name": "both_permission_and_prohibition"}, {"meaning": "完整供应窗口没有明示处置后留存许可或禁止；全量处置本身不改变此选择。", "name": "no_explicit_retention_effect_in_window"}], "examples": [], "name": "post_disposal_retention_effect_v1", "question": "判断供应窗口是否明示处置后的留存许可或留存禁止。不得仅因要求返还或销毁全部材料就称其为 explicit retention prohibition。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law. ”→explicit_retention_permission；“Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.”→explicit_retention_prohibition；“However, notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, 1) neither party will be required to delete electronic Confidential Information stored in back-up/archival storage in accordance with its policies, provided that any such retained Confidential Information will continue to be subject to the terms of this Confidentiality Agreement until it is destroyed by the receiving party; and”→explicit_retention_permission；“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→no_explicit_retention_effect_in_window。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disposal_post_disposal_retention_effect_v1__20_24", "operation": "post_disposal_retention_effect_v1", "unit_ids": [20, 21, 24], "current_units": [{"id": 20, "text": "In the event that no such protective order or other remedy is obtained, or that the Parties waive compliance with the terms of this letter agreement, the Parties will furnish only that portion of the Information which they are advised by counsel is legally required and will exercise all commercially reasonable efforts to obtain reliable assurance that confidential treatment will be accorded the Information."}, {"id": 21, "text": "3. If COMPANY or COMSYS determines not to proceed with the Transaction, they will promptly inform the other Party of that decision and, in that case, and at any time upon request of COMPANY or COMSYS or any of their Representatives, the other party will either (i) promptly destroy all copies of the written Information in its or its Representatives’ possession and confirm such destruction to the initiating company in writing or (ii) promptly deliver to the initiator of such action all copies of the written Information in its or its Representatives’ possession."}, {"id": 24, "text": "Any oral Information will continue to be subject to the terms of this letter agreement."}]}]}
